title: Let nature lead shirt
slide_intent: Choose a concise statement that can carry identity beyond a logo so clothing communicates a point of view.
strategic_value: The nature-led phrase can extend Sweetgreen’s values into an object people wear.
demonstration: A black shirt lies in dense green vegetation with white serif words Let Nature Lead stacked across it.
practical_value: Compare a values-led garment message with a purely logo-led treatment.

content_islands.name: Garment message
content_islands.spec: Keep the three stacked words prominent on the dark shirt.

content_islands.name: Natural setting
content_islands.spec: Surround the garment with leaves and small yellow flowers.

reference_purposes.Application: The brand’s nature-oriented message is applied to a shirt.
reference_purposes.Expression: White serif text contrasts with the black fabric and green setting.
